slot_note: oviya13ya's Anomaly Detection lane, wave 2; seed AD07 (world, decision and quantity kept; the seed's idle-position cap is F3's dead per-candidate constraint, so the pitfall is re-found)
niche: posting a national screening agency's one mobile screening team to one of eight flagged airports for the summer peak, judged by the passengers it moves within the 20-minute queue standard, when host airports release their own officers while the team is there
stakeholder_role: head of screening operations at a national aviation security agency, who posts the agency's one mobile screening team for the summer peak

spine.entity: one screening lane in one 15-minute interval at one airport checkpoint, summer 2026, with passengers screened (local and mobile-team lanes)
spine.source: synthetic (fictional national screening agency's lane sensors)

world.geography: fictional country (Kestland), North Atlantic island republic, English-speaking
world.org_type: national aviation security agency that screens passengers at eight airports and keeps one mobile screening team

driver: When a shared resource is posted to a unit, the unit's own managers may release part of their own resource for the time it is there, so the shared resource's own output overstates what the unit gains; the gain is the net change in the unit's total resource, read from past postings interval by interval against the unit's plan, and where the release falls only in quiet intervals the gain at the busy ones is untouched, so neither the gross addition nor a day-averaged release ranks the units right.
driver_concrete: Last summer's postings show that while the mobile team's three lanes were open, several airports' duty managers sent two of their own lanes' officers to recurrent training: all day at the airports the gross three-lane queue run ranks first, and only in the midday and late-evening troughs at one airport ranked fourth; the queue standard's passengers moved within 20 minutes therefore follow the net lanes by interval, and that airport, whose peak gain is the full three lanes, is where the team moves the most.
stump: A competent solver runs the queue standard on each airport's 2027 design-day forecast and summer roster plan with the team's three lanes added and posts the team to Cullinvale, where it moves the most passengers within 20 minutes; the step that lands it there is taking the planned lanes plus three as the lanes that will be open, when last summer's postings show Cullinvale's duty managers, like two other airports', sent two of their own lanes' officers to training all day while the team was there, and Halloran Bay's only in its midday and late-evening troughs, so Halloran Bay's peaks gain the full three lanes and the team moves the most passengers there.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the planning standard, the summer 2027 forecasts and roster plans and the deployment log correctly adds the team's three lanes to each airport's planned lanes, runs the queue standard and posts the team where it moves the most passengers within 20 minutes, wrong because the host airports' own lanes open while the team was there fell short of their plan last summer, all day at the leaders and only off-peak at the right airport.
domain_test: The deciding analysis is checkpoint capacity planning: a fluid queue on 15-minute arrivals against the lanes actually open, scored against the 20-minute wait standard, with the lanes a posting adds read net of the host's own response from the lane sensors and duty rosters of past postings; with another field's nouns there is no lane, queue standard, wait threshold or host duty roster, and the task stops making sense.
notes: Seed AD07's own mechanism (the team opens lanes only where a lane position stands idle, a per-airport cap that re-places the pick) is the dead F3 shape (58 v3 and v4) and its pick-one shape 01 is banned against task181 and task183; the decision and quantity are kept, the pitfall is re-found as interference: the host's response to the posting. Shape 13 (each airport's posting a scenario, the flip the host release at peak that would move the call) because 07 and 01 are banned against task180 and task181.
